shortDescription: Democratic candidate Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins has been elected governor of Alaska, according to projections by the Associated Press and NBC News, the latest win for the party in a wave of midterm state government and US congressional election victories.

children: Democratic candidate Jonathan Kreiss-Tomkins has been elected governor of Alaska, according to projections by the Associated Press and NBC News, the latest win for the party in a wave of midterm state government and US congressional election victories.
Kreiss-Tomkins, 37, a former Alaska state lawmaker, defeated three Republicans, including one backed by US President Donald Trump
Alaska has not elected a Democratic governor since 1998, according to US media
Kreiss-Tomkins' victory would give Democrats 30 state governorships next year following the November 3
He campaigned on reducing the cost of living, full funding for public schools, and regulating data center construction
Kreiss-Tomkins was endorsed by Republican US Senator Lisa Murkowski, one of the few members of her party who has been willing to break with Trump on some foreign and domestic issues
